setups.name: Leader Pullback
setups.desc: Leader back at its 21 EMA, uptrend intact, sellers drying up: buy the dip, not the chase.

setups.name: Rotation Rookie
setups.desc: A theme or sub-theme money is newly moving into; the stock hasn't run yet.

setups.name: Qullamaggie Flag
setups.desc: High-ADR top performer basing in a tight flag after a big leg (any theme). Buy the flag break, stop low of day, hold 3-5 days, trail the 10 EMA.

setups.name: Round Number Magnet
setups.desc: Strong stock a short hop under a big round number ($50, $100, $200...): the level draws price in, and a clean break above it often runs.

setups.name: Minervini VCP
setups.desc: Young Stage 2 trend tightening up with volume drying out. Buy the pivot break, stop under the last contraction (max 8%), hold while above the 50-day.

brief.headline: AI debt fears hit tech as the 10-year holds near 5.1% after a hot CPI, while Brent tests $110 on Middle East supply risk.
brief.rates: 10-year about 5.08% and up roughly 8% over 60 days; 2-year near 4.71%, so the curve steepened Friday; a hot CPI has a rate hike being debated.
brief.oil: Brent tested $110 and WTI about $101 midday Friday on supply risk; the IEA is speeding up emergency stock releases and the US may ease some tanker sanctions.
brief.fed: No FOMC meeting or major Fed speaker on next week's calendar; hike talk after CPI is the live theme.
brief.geo: Iran tensions remain the oil wildcard (talk of new strikes on nuclear sites).

reasons.text: Breadth thrust on 2026-10-15. Switch to the post-thrust playbook: Rotation Rookie (+0.37R), Leader Pullback (+0.30R), Minervini VCP (+0.29R); pause Episodic pivots.

Breadth has been Weak for 3+ sessions; the setups were chosen in Mixed breadth. In weak breadth so far: Round Number Magnet -0.03R, ATH Magnet +0.03R, Leader Pullback +0.10R, Rotation Rookie +0.06R, Qullamaggie Flag +0.38R, Minervini VCP +0.13R.
Minervini VCP is slumping: -0.25R a trade over its last 75 signals.
Leadership has rotated: 4 of the top 5 themes are new since the review (TRANSPORT - Shipping, HEALTHCARE - Services, TECH - Software, BIOTECH - Pharma).
